Stock traders, quantitative analysts, and portfolio managers use Alpha Vantage to download historical OHLCV (open, high, low, close, volume) data, get real-time and historical price quotes, and measure technical indicators and fundamental data for any ticker symbol.

Alpha Vantage APIs are organized into the following categories:

  • Core Time Series APIs: These APIs return the most recent and historical price/volume data for a given ticker symbol. There are four time series APIs:
    • TIME_SERIES_INTRADAY: Returns the most recent and historical intraday OHLCV data for a ticker symbol. The user can specify the interval (1min, 5min, 15min, 30min, 60min).
    • TIME_SEREE_DAILY: Returns daily open,igh, low, close, volume (OHLCV) data for the most recent 20+ years.
    • TIME_SERIES_WEEKLY: Returns weekly OHLCV data for the most recent 20+ years.
    • TIME_SERIES_MONTHLY: Returns weekly OHLCV data for the most recent 20+ years.
  • Fundamental Data APIs: These APIs return the annual and quarterly income statements, balance sheets, cash flow statements, and other fundamental data for a given ticker symbol.
  • Digital Currencies APIs: These APIs are designed for digital currency markets. They return real-time and historical exchange rate data for any digital/crypto currency.
  • Forex APIs: These APIs are designed for the foreign exchange market.. They return real-time and historical exchange rate data for any physical currency.
  • Technical Indicators APIs: These APIs return technical indicators such as SMA, EMA, WMA, DEMA, TEMA, TRIMA, KAMA, MAMA, VWAP, and many more for a given ticker symbol.
